boundedQuestion: Does Weather Mother R48 provide a retrievable, exact-subject performance receipt that can support the commit claim that interactive and clear-sky frame rates improved?

subject.commitMessage: weather: improve interactive and clear sky frame rates R48

decision.reason: R48 contains a real source change and honestly disclaims visual equivalence, but the referenced local test record is absent from the exact committed subject and no exact path, digest, environment, paired baseline/candidate measurements, or workflow receipt is retrievable.

novelty.reason: The failure is an exact-subject Delivery Receipt/freshness closure instance already covered by R2 and TASK_FRESHNESS_AND_NO_STALE_DELIVERY_GATE; no new regression or OS change is warranted.

requirements: Commit one exact receipt path and SHA-256 bound to both R47 and R48 blobs.
Record device, OS, browser/version, GPU/driver, power state, viewport, render resolution, scene, parameters, warmup, sample window and visibility state.
Run paired R47/R48 measurements under the same protocol and publish raw frame intervals plus at least median FPS and p95 frame time; invalidate disjoint GPU timer samples.
Bind fixed-view visual comparison or explicitly keep visual equivalence UNKNOWN.
Fail closed when the receipt path or any bound blob is missing or mismatched.

boundaries: No production Mother, main, R2, gate, public preview or asset was modified.
No browser, hardware GPU, device, production, visual or user acceptance was run.
This result does not reject the R48 source delta; it limits the performance claim to an unverified Observation.
